$comment: One table of subscribe requests and the filter each resolves to, driven through BOTH runtimes: tests/unit/test_subscription_filters.py and packages/server-node/test/subscription-filters.test.mjs read this file and assert the same result and the same refusal. The same pattern as argument-validation.json, and for the same reason — two hand-written copies of a rule are two rules. Nothing here touches an OPC UA server: this is the part of a subscribe request that is decidable from the call alone. What is *not* here is the percent deadband's EURange requirement, which needs the node, and is covered end to end in tests/e2e/test_engineering_units_e2e.py.

cases.name: an omitted filter asks for nothing the server would not do anyway
an explicit 'none' is the same as omitting it
'none' discards a deadband_value rather than pretending it applies
an absolute deadband in engineering units
a percent deadband, which is a percentage of EURange
a zero deadband is a real answer, not a missing one
watching a tag go bad without caring what it reads
telling 'the value is steady' from 'the value stopped updating'
a deadband and a trigger together

cases.$comment: A deadband needs a size. Refused rather than defaulted to zero, which would be a deadband that filters nothing while reporting that one is in force — the caller would read a buffer full of jitter and conclude the tag was noisier than their threshold, which it may not be. This is a relationship *between* two arguments, so the contract's own `enum` cannot express it and the runtimes have to.
cases.name: an absolute deadband with no size
cases.error: subscribe_opcua_nodes requires deadband_value when deadband_type is "absolute"

cases.name: a percent deadband with no size
cases.error: subscribe_opcua_nodes requires deadband_value when deadband_type is "percent"

cases.name: a deadband kind OPC UA does not have
cases.error: subscribe_opcua_nodes argument deadband_type must be one of "none", "absolute", "percent", got "relative"

cases.name: a trigger OPC UA does not have
cases.error: subscribe_opcua_nodes argument data_change_trigger must be one of "status", "statusValue", "statusValueTimestamp", got "value"
